lines: MY BOSS SAID: "WE NEED TO TALK."
AT THIS POINT HE'S NOT CIRCLING.
WHEN MY BOSS SAYS "YOU'RE DOING GREAT,"
AND IT'S ALWAYS BIGGER THAN MY RAISE.
WHEN MY BOSS SAYS "WE'RE A FAMILY HERE,"
BECAUSE IN MY FAMILY WE YELL, WE GOSSIP,
MY BOSS ASKED WHERE I SEE MYSELF IN FIVE YEARS.
MY BOSS: "CAN YOU STAY LATE TONIGHT?"
MY PLANS: LIE ON THE FLOOR
AND STARE AT THE CEILING UNTIL I FEEL SOMETHING.
ME AT 8:59 AM: TODAY I'M GOING TO BE SO PRODUCTIVE.
ME AT 9:01 AM, AFTER ONE EMAIL FROM MY BOSS:
I'M MOVING IN WITH THE RACCOONS.
I'M NOT IN A TOXIC RELATIONSHIP.
BUT THIS ONE HAS A DRESS CODE.
